Written to `HANDOFF.md`.

The short version. Roll back `dep-4471`, the gateway config change at 02:12. It flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`, so every request grabs its own connection from a pool of 20. Impact runs 02:14:19 to at least 03:59, where the log ends.

One number I got wrong earlier. There are four upstreams, not five. All four fail evenly.

Two things in the file you may not expect. Every non-health request has failed since onset, so it is 100% of real traffic. And this log is node-3 of 3, so check the other two nodes.
